# Ramp

> > Ramp is an AI-powered spend management platform that automates corporate cards, expense management, accounts payable, and finance operations for mid-market and enterprise companies.

Ramp provides an integrated suite of financial automation tools including corporate cards, expense management, AP automation, procurement, accounting, treasury, and travel management. The platform leverages AI agents and machine learning to streamline finance operations, reduce manual work, and improve cash flow visibility across organizations.

## Key Topics

- Spend Management
- Corporate Cards
- Accounts Payable Automation
- Expense Management
- Ramp Intelligence
- Finance Automation
- AI-Powered Workflows
- Procurement Management
- Treasury Management
- Accounting Automation
- Cost Savings
- Policy Enforcement
- Approval Workflows
- ERP Integration
- Multi-Currency Support

## Core Products

- [Ramp Intelligence](https://ramp.com/intelligence): AI agents for expense, AP, and finance automation to 10X your team's impact
- [Corporate Cards](https://ramp.com/corporate-cards): Virtual and physical corporate cards with spend controls, real-time controls, and rewards
- [Expense Management](https://ramp.com/expense-management): Automated expense tracking, approval workflows, and reporting with policy enforcement
- [Accounts Payable](https://ramp.com/accounts-payable): AI-powered AP automation with touchless invoice processing and bill pay
- [Procurement](https://ramp.com/procurement): AI-powered intake-to-pay procurement with vendor management and approval workflows
- [Accounting Automation](https://ramp.com/accounting-automation-software): AI-powered accounting close with ERP integration and financial consolidation
- [Treasury Management](https://ramp.com/treasury): Corporate treasury services with high-yield business accounts and cash management
- [Corporate Travel](https://ramp.com/travel): Corporate travel booking platform integrated with expense management
